findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: There is soil residue observed under the racks where sausage is stored in the display cooler. This was discussed with the PIC. The PIC instructed an employee to clean this area. Ensure that non-food contact surfaces are cleaned as often as necessary to maintain them clean.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Inspector observed 22 cans to be rusted, severely dented, or dented along a seam. Discussed with PIC, and all cans were disposed of immediately. Ensure that dented (sharp dent or seam dent), rusted, or bulged cans are thrown away and not sold to customers.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Inspector observed 4 papayas and several yellow summer squashes to be molding on the retail shelf. Discussed with PIC and all moldy foods were discarded. Ensure that moldy food is removed from shelves and not sold to customers.
findings.citation_text: 3-101.11 Safe, Unadulterated, and Honestly Presented. FOOD shall be safe, unADULTERATED, and, as specified under § 3-601.12, honestly presented.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Bakery line hand sink was observed to need caulk along the top of the sink.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure sink is caulked to prevent mold growth between sink and wall and to create a smooth and easily cleanable surface.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
No paper towels were available at time of inspection.  Discussed with PIC, the dispenser was filled on-site.  Ensure hand sinks are properly supplied at all times.

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Bakery line sink was observed to need caulk along the top of the sink.  Discussed with PIC, who will contact maintenance.  Ensure sink is caulked to prevent mold growth between sink and wall.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Fan grates in walk-in cooler were observed to contain an accumulation of dust.  Discussed with PIC, who will contact maintenance.  Ensure grates in walk-in cooler and freezer are cleaned regularly to prevent dust accumulation.

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
